items.title: Does AbbVie (ABBV) Need This New Solid Tumor Cancer Partnership?
items.summary: AbbVie (NYSE:ABBV) and DISCO Pharmaceuticals announced a new collaboration to develop bispecific cancer therapies for solid tumors. The agreement focuses on applying DISCO Pharmaceuticals' proprietary bispecific technology platform to AbbVie's oncology research programs. The partnership is intended to expand AbbVie's pipeline of next generation cancer drugs targeting solid tumor indications.
